body:
NFL DFS Projections Week 12: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 10:02 PM ET

Joe Burrow carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate: 23.9 DraftKings points at $7,700. He holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 50,000 simulations. Bijan Robinson holds the largest share at 37% for $7,700.

Behind Burrow, the model's next four projections are Ja'Marr Chase (23.4, $8,900), Bijan Robinson (22.4, $7,700), Trevor Lawrence (21.6, $6,700) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.5, $9,100). Trevor Lawrence returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.22 projected points per $1,000. Ja'Marr Chase leads the wide receivers at 23.4 for $8,900, Joe Burrow leads the quarterbacks at 23.9 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 16.6 for $6,600.

The 9-game slate runs from a 50.5-point total in NO at CIN down to 35.5 in NE at LAC. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 10:02 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 50,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 12 DraftKings projections

Joe Burrow, CIN vs NO ($7,700)

Joe Burrow carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.9 DraftKings points at $7,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.3 points clear of Trevor Lawrence. The salary works out to 3.10 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 12 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Burrow averaged 24.0 points with a simulated floor of 9.6 and a ceiling of 44.1, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 10-point favorite at home against New Orleans, with an implied team total of 30.25 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Trevor Lawrence, JAX vs TEN ($6,700)

Trevor Lawrence projects 2nd at the position with 21.6 DraftKings points at $6,700, 4th on the main slate overall. The model includes 3.5 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.22 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 12 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Lawrence averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 40.4, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: J.J. McCarthy, NYG at IND ($5,400)

J.J. McCarthy projects for 17.5 DraftKings points at $5,400, which works out to 3.24 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 12 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 3.3 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations McCarthy averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 32.0, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Giants are a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 41.5.
